statement: Seller reports the transfer (Form 29) within 14 days of the transfer for a vehicle registered in the same State and sends a copy of the report to the buyer.
Buyer reports the transfer within 30 days of the transfer to the registering authority with the RC and fee.
Buyer applies in Form 30 within 14 days of the transfer for a vehicle registered within the same State.

If the seller or buyer reports late, the registering authority may require payment of an amount prescribed by the State (which may vary with the delay) in lieu of action under s.177; if it is not paid, action under s.177 follows. The West Bengal amount is not in the registry.
Exclude the day of transfer when counting; due date = transfer_date + window_days. MVA s.50 does not state a counting method; team adopts the General Clauses Act convention.
No entry of transfer of ownership is made for a vehicle under hypothecation without the written consent of the financier named in the RC.

locator: Consent of the financier + Office endorsement
statement: With the financier's consent on Form 30, the transfer is recorded under continuation of the hypothecation agreement with the transferee. Central route confirmed; West Bengal availability pending official confirmation.
Hypothecation is removed by Form 35 signed by the registered owner and the financier with the financier's certificate of due clearance.
Form 34 is used to enter a new hypothecation in the RC (including a transferee's new agreement); it does not remove an existing loan.
Form 28 NOC is needed when the vehicle is removed or sold outside the registering authority's jurisdiction (within or outside the State). Out of scope for this prototype.
